scripts.sort: bun run bin/sort-locales.ts && git add src/_locales/*/messages.json
scripts.locale-check: bun run bin/find-invalid-variables.ts && bun run bin/missing-locales.ts
scripts.locales: bun run locale-check && bun run sort
scripts.checks: bun run fmt && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run locales && bun run dev-firefox
scripts.dev-firefox: bun run src/manifest/build-manifest.mjs firefox && bun run bundle
scripts.dev-chrome: bun run src/manifest/build-manifest.mjs chrome && bun run bundle
scripts.dev-edge: bun run src/manifest/build-manifest.mjs edge && bun run bundle
scripts.dev-safari: bun run src/manifest/build-manifest.mjs safari && bun run bundle
scripts.build-firefox: bun run dev-firefox && bash bin/zip-extension.bash firefox
scripts.build-chrome: bun run dev-chrome && bash bin/zip-extension.bash chrome
scripts.build-edge: bun run dev-edge && bash bin/zip-extension.bash edge
scripts.build-safari: bun run dev-safari && bash bin/zip-extension.bash safari && bash bin/convert-to-safari-app-extension.bash
